findings.problem: Converting NPZ scores or control columns to Python floats could erase a float32 source dtype even when its values matched numerically.
findings.resolution: Monthly.selection now requires float64 scores and the exact vector shape. Monthly.controls requires float64 score/net_base/net_adverse columns before converting to records.
findings.verification: Read final guards and independently ran real Monthly admission fixtures rejecting float32 NPZ/control columns and malformed score shape; signed-zero control rejection also passed.
